triggering_merge_pr.title: Keep Azure DevOps logging commands unwrapped in CLI pipeline output
triggering_merge_pr.author: davidfowl

candidate_merges.message: Keep Azure DevOps logging commands unwrapped in CLI pipeline output (#21487) ## Description With `--pipeline-log-level debug`, `aspire publish`, `deploy` and `do` forward child-process output, such as `dotnet publish (stdout): ...`, through `ConsoleActivityLogger`. That logger renders each line with Spectre's `MarkupLine`, which hard-wraps at the console width: 160 columns when output is redirected in CI, or `ASPIRE_CONSOLE_WIDTH`.
